LightningComponentBundle.description: Page chrome for a single calculator: breadcrumb, h1, a slot for the calculator, and a related-calculators strip.

property.name: breadcrumbs
property.label: Breadcrumbs
property.description: Comma separated Label|url pairs. The current page title is appended automatically.

property.name: relatedCalculators
property.label: Related Calculators
property.description: Comma separated Label|url pairs, e.g. Goal Planner|/calculators/goal-planner. Leave blank to hide the strip.

property.name: hideDefaultCalculator
property.label: Hide Default Calculator
property.description: The SIP and Lumpsum calculator renders inside this layout by default. Tick this on pages that host a different calculator.
